milestone: SeLinOS memd fixed mapping inventory reservation M1

contract.request: Only a two-word RESERVE_FIXED_PLAN request for slot 1 is accepted.
contract.state: The first exact request transitions memd-local state from FREE to RESERVED; the second exact request returns EBUSY and leaves state RESERVED.
contract.authority: Root delegates only the client endpoint to memd and its probe. Memd receives no allocator, VSpace, page-table, frame, mapping, task, device, IRQ, DMA, PCI, I/O or IOSpace authority.

required_markers: SeLinOS memd M1: fixed mapping-plan slot 1 reserved without mapping.
SeLinOS memd M1: duplicate fixed-plan slot 1 reservation rejected with EBUSY.
SeLinOS memd M1: fixed mapping-plan reservation-state proof passed.
SeLinOS memd M1 probe: one-slot fixed-plan reserve then EBUSY passed.
forbidden_markers: SeLinOS memd M1: malformed fixed-plan reservation rejected.
SeLinOS memd M1 probe: fixed-plan reservation sequence rejected.

not_claimed: VSpace, page-table, frame, stack, image or mapping allocation
executable mapping, W^X, native ELF loading or dynamic linker semantics
capability lease transfer, revocation, reuse, teardown or dynamic task creation
Linux clone, fork, pthread, process exit, wait, signal or futex semantics
device, IRQ, DMA, PCI, I/O or IOSpace authority
